document_statements.quote: Inter-regional transfer limit variation - Directlink all 3 cables - NSW region - 31/07/2026.
A planned outage of Directlink all 3 cables in the NSW region was scheduled from 0700 hrs 27/07/2026 to 1700 hrs 31/07/2026.
The outage has been completed and Directlink all 3 cables returned to service at 1430 hrs 31/07/2026 Constraint set(s) revoked: N-X_MBTE_3 Manager NEM Real Time Operations
